summary: A size and color wrapper for SVG icons so they stay on-token.
purpose: Wrap any SVG so size and color resolve from the system. Do not drop raw SVGs with hardcoded fills into screens.

anatomy.description: The child SVG, sized and colored by the wrapper.

props.name: size
props.description: Icon box size in px via the size map.

props.name: color
props.description: Semantic token color string for the fill.

whenToUse: Any glyph inside buttons, lists, or empty states.

do: Give meaning via adjacent text or aria-label on the parent.
dont: Hardcode fill hex on the SVG.

aria: If the icon alone carries meaning, set aria-label on the interactive parent.
accessibility.contrast: Glyph against background holds at least 3:1.

related.whenToChoose: Icon-only actions still need a Button with aria-label.
